headings.instruction: Do not use Inter for headings. Ensure H1 is expressive.

mono.instruction: Use for activity feed, logs, and technical identifiers.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Optical Clarity' Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px border-white/10) for floating panels like the activity feed or sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid border-zinc-800 for cards, hover to border-zinc-700. Remove border on the last item of a row to create an open edge.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Rely on 1px borders and slight background lightening for elevation. Use glow drop-shadows ONLY for the 'Verified' status or active running node.
visual_enhancers.nodes: React Flow nodes must be sleek, dark mode specific with colored left borders denoting status (e.g., border-l-4 border-l-emerald-500 for verified, border-l-amber-500 for revising).

layouts.dashboard: Centered hero layout with generous spacing (py-24 or py-32) for the mission input. 'Bento' grid below for example missions. The 'HIVE IT' input should be massive (text-2xl or text-3xl) to feel consumer-friendly.
layouts.mission_room: High-Density Grid. Full height (h-screen). Top Nav. The main body is a flex or grid layout: Main canvas takes up 75% width, Right Sidebar (Workforce) takes 25%. The Bottom Feed (Activity) floats at the bottom of the main canvas or is a dedicated bottom pane (h-1/4).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md with hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0 transition-transform. The 'HIVE IT' button must be visually prominent.
components.react_flow: Use @xyflow/react. Nodes must be custom components (MissionManagerNode, AgentNode) with styled handles and status indicators. Hide default xyflow attribution via CSS if needed, or style controls to match dark theme.
components.activity_feed: Terminal-like or clean list view. Monospace font for timestamps and agent names. Color-coded dots for events (green=success, yellow=warning/recovery, blue=info).
components.cards: Use flat backgrounds with 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. On hover, slight lift and subtle glow.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1. Never use pure transparent backgrounds over content.
accessibility.data-testid: Mandatory on all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, nodes, and feed items.

media.icons: lucide-react (already installed). Use heavily for agent roles and status (CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, Activity, Loader2, GitMerge). DO NOT use AI emojis.
media.images: Use the provided abstract data URL sparingly for empty states or dashboard background texture.

example_mission_bg.description: Abstract data nodes on black surface. Use as an extremely low opacity (opacity-10) background texture for the Dashboard, or on example mission cards.

3d_libraries.react_flow: Required for the Agent/Task dependency GRAPH. Install @xyflow/react.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute `yarn add @xyflow/react dagre` before starting the implementation.
Build the 'HIVE' Dashboard with a large, consumer-friendly input field and a 'HIVE IT' button. Clicking it navigates to the Mission Room.
In the Mission Room, use @xyflow/react to build the DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) showing the workforce tasks. You can use 'dagre' for auto-layout or hardcode node positions for the MVP.
Create custom node types in React Flow (e.g., AgentNode) that display the agent's role, current status, and task.

Simulate the workflow execution visually. The DAG nodes should change state sequentially over time using setTimeout or a state machine (Pending -> Running -> Needs Revision/Error -> Recovery -> Verified).

CRITICAL: Highlight the error-recovery/responsibility flow. When a node hits an error, change its border to Amber, show a warning icon, log an event to the bottom feed ('⚠ Reviewer detected an inconsistency', '↻ routed issue to...'), then transition it to 'revising' and eventually 'completed'.
The final node must be 'Verification'. Once completed, mark the mission as 'VERIFIED' with a prominent green highlight across the UI.
The Right panel must show the Workforce list with live status sync to the graph.
The Bottom panel must be a live activity/event feed that appends typed events with icons as the graph progresses.
Prioritize workflow logic and the React Flow simulation. It needs to look like a real AI workforce is collaborating.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
